comparison.scope: One shared continuation environment with direct resume/cancel code; no reuse analysis or last-use finalization.

compiler_source.method: Three alternating fresh-process pairs pinned to CPU 2. Both compilers read the same current bootstrap/compile.sld and src libraries. WAT generation only; no linking.

values.only_wat_difference: The frame type second field changes from mutable dropper reference to immutable frame.code reference. All other WAT is identical.

siege.only_wat_difference: The frame type second field changes from mutable dropper reference to immutable frame.code reference. All other WAT is identical.

regression.contract: Inside-out cancellation, reverse binding order. Baseline backup credits delay Rc finalizers; current weak observers report dead. Ordinary lexical lifetime and last-use policy unchanged.
